text: OVERDOSAGE Flunisolide, infused intravenously, at doses up to 4 mg/kg in mice, rats and dogs (approximately 45,300 and 90 times, respectively, the maximum recommended daily intranasal dose in adults and children on a mg/m 2 basis) was without lethality.
